sets.relationshipLabel: a time or weather event and the activity or occasion it brings
sets.explanation: Winter and snowfall are conditions that necessarily open the door to skiing and snow days, so each pair links a weather state to what it enables.

sets.relationshipLabel: a snow form and the water it becomes through melting
sets.explanation: A snowman and a snowfall both end the same way once the temperature turns, leaving a puddle or meltwater behind.

sets.relationshipLabel: two names for the same winter object
sets.explanation: A toboggan is just another word for a sled, and a toque is the same hat as a beanie under a different regional name.

sets.relationshipLabel: a snow mass and a structural feature it has
sets.explanation: A snowdrift wears a crust the way an iceberg carries a keel — each is a defining structural part of the larger mass.
